digest.en: Uganda's emergency food handouts dominate headlines after 19 deaths from hunger. Meanwhile, the LTA's transport plan consultations in Singapore have sparked debate over merging COE Categories A and B. In a separate development, China's AI push gains momentum as it takes the satellite race with SpaceX to the high seas.
